title: Fix Missing Tree Indentation Lines
description: Some vertical indentation lines are missing in UI trees (e.g. puzzle 3d document: objects > hexagonal cut concrete > object tree items). Ensure all ancestor guide lines render consistently.
summary: Fixed missing vertical tree indentation guides for expanded last-sibling rows (e.g. puzzle 3D document object vortices). `IndentationLines` now always draws the immediate parent-level guide through child branches while still suppressing deeper ancestor guides after last siblings. `TreeSection` also receives `isLastSection` from the data `Tree` so section-level guides stop correctly after the final section.
